notes.title: Dropsy Version 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
2016.02.05 - Version 1.4
----------------------------------------
'Clown About Town' achievement is now unlockable
'The Perfect Storm' achievement is now unlockable
'Tapeworm' achievement is now unlockable
'The Moistening' achievement is now unlockable
'Tight Pants' achievement is now unlockable
'What Does It Say About His Clown Level!?' achievement is now unlockable
When Dropsy is holding an item, an icon is now displayed in the bottom right
Fix music in church after Preacher's puzzle has been solved
Change bracelet sprite to be more effective and positioned correctly
Added blinking hug button to end of Chickenman's dialog
Remove floating 'ghost' cursors from various scenes
Fix map markers to properly appear for bird's mom and megacircus
Removed fade bugs from circus training cutscene
Fix bug where leaving the screen while dog is peeing locks the game
Dropsy will no longer be able to hide from the cops in his bedroom
Fixed minor bug with brothers picture
Fixed bug with walkable area in the skyscraper exterior
Edit various dialog icons
Parallax fix in Nightclub
Various minor tinting and Z-sort fixes
********** TABLETS **********
Parity between PC and tablet versions
Add touch feedback for tapping
Implemented WalkDestination for puff effect
Larger tappable areas for toolbar buttons
Inventory item large view polish
Fix a critical game hang during police chase sequence
Refocus scene where Dropsy's sleeping if in 4:3
Focus camera on Homeless Lady if in 4:3
Fix weird jittering on end-game credits roll

notes.title: Dropsy Update V1.3
notes.content:
Details: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/274350/discussions/0/492378265879324770/

2015.11.20 - Version 1.3
----------------------------------------
- Achievements added to Steam
- Updated title screen with additional animation and aspect ratio support
- Refactored Cameras, and fixed cursor tracking to match
- Clamp resolution to individual display to fix spreading over multiple monitors on Linux systems
- Add map marker after Dad's motorcycle tire is stolen
- Fixed/re-enabled the all-important fart button
- Update scrolling on world map screen
- Windows now close when switching companion
- Fixed a bug with the junkyard mutant rat puzzle that could lock the game
- Correct an issue where peeing on hydrants could be interrupted
- Costume shop owner now tells Eughh how much he hates Dropsy
- Fix walkable area in subway so Dropsy can't walk beyond the darkness
- Fix positioning on church preacher at various times of day
- Edit settings on proximity sounds
- Fix bug with parallax layers causing glitchiness
- Various other minor bugfixes
- Change name of screensize setting to Screensize rather than Fullscreen

notes.title: Dropsy Version 1.2 patch notes [spoilers]
notes.content:
1.2 Patch Notes
Dropsy Version 1.2 patch notes
----------------------------------------------------

    Beds now allow selection of wake-up time
    Dream sequences occur only while sleeping at home
    Day cycle slightly elongated, and night cycle slightly shortened
    Can now hug church volunteer after completing church puzzle thread
    Fix black screen bug caused by the shed cutscene
    Rework screen fading to fix various related bugs
    Adjust how world map displays scene dots
    Opening the world map now properly stops the player walker
    Add options menu button to return to title screen
    Allow hugging southern snack guard and add polish to both snack guards
    Fix camera monitors to properly show the current state of the tram cars and dog
    Give hydrant robot dialogue related to dog getting lost
    Add closeups to the tables outside the mine and the airport
    Dog will correctly warn Dropsy when trying to leave while searching for bird's mother
    Dog will walk to Dropsy to ask for his sock to be put on the grave if he was offscreen
    Give the chickenman a 'free hugs' sign
    Correctly enable toll booth drawing on the hug wall
    Make Thor amulet easier to collect outside the mine entrance
    Can show the bracelet to the preacher while in the playground
    Dropsy can attempt to hug the hologram
    Grand opening news on TV when Dropsy wakes up on opening morning
    Circus music plays across scenes on opening day
    Add details to costume shop and graveyard to hint at costume shop owner
    Polish added to costume shop owner both in costume shop and in graveyard
    Both brothers have a copy of the repaired photo after being reunited
    Remove dog's barking from mine after you've rescued him
    Ejected tape sprite in church now matches the tape correctly
    Add hospital signs
    Rat bangs around inside tub after Dropsy traps it
    Adjust parallax backgrounds in junkyard and desert
    Move rocks to foreground in cave passage scene
    Minor graphical edits to airport scene
    Edit Kickstarter credits for non 16:9 screens
    Adjust various object colliders
    Correct object tints in various scenes
